integrity.claim_consistency: The same balanced square-root theorem and the explicit two-class sign split are stated across the public files.
integrity.proof_scope: The general result follows by normalized primitive-block contraction and summable second-order scalar products.
integrity.verification: A standard-library rational checker confirms the four-state example in all start phases and both classes; numerical log-slopes are illustrative.

scientific_limitations: Finite state spaces, fixed support and phase synchronization; the polynomial law requires zero first-order block drift.
The leading constants are positive but are not given as elementary closed forms.
The verification code checks example algebra and finite-horizon diagnostics, not infinite-horizon convergence.
Broader abstract difference-equation asymptotic priority may be relevant and is not definitively resolved.
title: Opposite survival power laws from balanced periodic square-root perturbations
